# Regenerative & Hormone Medicine (RHM)

> RHM is a physician-led hormone and regenerative medicine practice for women and men. It helps patients understand what is affecting how they feel and function (energy, sleep, weight, mood, libido, hormone changes), then builds personalized treatment plans for long-term health. Care is available in person at three offices and by telehealth in all U.S. states.

Every statement below comes from pages on www.rhmmed.com. For medical questions, the site's articles and treatment pages are the source; RHM does not give individual advice outside a consultation.

## How care works

- First step: a VIP call (https://www.rhmmed.com/scheduling), the start of becoming an RHM patient.
- Evaluation: more than 160 biomarkers are evaluated per patient, read together rather than one marker at a time.
- Plan: a licensed medical provider builds and manages a personalized treatment plan, with ongoing monitoring and adjustments.
- Telehealth: secure video, phone or in-person consultations; lab work is done locally; medications are shipped to the patient's door; 24/7 patient portal.
- The practice cites 573+ five-star patient reviews and 20+ years of hormone optimization experience.

## Clinicians

- Rand McClain, DO: regenerative medicine and hormone replacement therapy specialist in Santa Monica, California, with a background in sports medicine and osteopathic care.
- Kristin Sewnig, MSN, FNP-BC: board-certified nurse practitioner specializing in hormone replacement therapy, menopause, thyroid health and metabolic wellness, with more than 25 years of clinical experience.

- Santa Monica: 2701 Ocean Park Blvd, Suite #114, Santa Monica, CA 90405. (310) 452-3206. Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

- Telehealth: all U.S. states.
